items.claim: ShortcutSheet draws Ctrl+"+" as one "Ctrl++" chip and its search can't find it
items.note: (parser reads a trailing `++` as the `+` key) and c0d679fe95 (rows draw chips from the shortcut data, which keeps the optional-Shift chip; 2bfa99e80f adds `ShortcutKeys`' `format` prop for this)

items.claim: ShortcutSheet keys a row's chips by formatted legend, so two bindings that read alike (`a`/`A`) collide
items.note: (one chip per distinct legend, keyed by it)

items.claim: Untitled SidebarPanel drops `onHide`, `actions`, `trailing`, `headerRef` and its fold control
items.note: (the header shows when any part is given or the panel folds; an untitled fold control is named "Contents", recorded in `docs/unruled.md`)

items.claim: SpanStrips with no `at` rounds the second-to-last row's corners
SpanStrips with no `at` rounds the wrong row
items.note: duplicate of A's SpanStrips finding, fixed d9dfd0c447

items.claim: rulerTicks has no cap on tick count, loops forever on a non-positive step, and drifts under a fractional step
items.note: (the fallback takes a whole multiple of the last step; a step that is not a positive finite number throws `RangeError`, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`; ticks are computed as `origin + i*step` with float slack)

items.claim: Switch hands a stale modifier set to `onChange` after a click that changed nothing
items.note: A native checkbox only changes through a click event, and a keyboard Space fires one too. That click's capture handler rewrites `mods` before `onChange` runs, so a stale Alt never reaches a change.

items.claim: Switch does not mirror under RTL
items.note: (`inset-inline-start`, plus a `:dir(rtl)` flip of the translate)

items.claim: Sequence keys cells by position, so state moves to another step
items.note: (keyed by the step's label, with an occurrence count to tell repeated labels apart)
